headline: Home Depot (HD) Stock Looks Fairly Valued After Reorganization Moves
summary: Home Depot stock has delivered a 13.3% total return over the past five years, yet current checks suggest the shares now sit close to intrinsic value rather than at a clear bargain or premium. With a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate pointing to the stock being fairly valued and market multiples also looking about right, recent share price softness raises the question of how much upside is left if execution on growth plans falters.
